summary:
I found one break of a hard line that should be fixed before shipping. Everything else I checked against the hard lines holds.

The break (must, hard line 10, and the weekly sheet's own promise "못 해도 잃는 건 없어"): production still has the weekly task "선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기" (id `gift`). This deploy removes it, and only the other removed task, "사흘 들어오기", gets the `kept` credit. A production save whose current week counts the gift task as done loses that point on the update. I seeded a week at 5/5 that included the gift task and had not been claimed. Production showed 5/5 with the gift dot. This build shows 4/5: the "주간 선물 받기" button and the dot are gone, and the gift task is replaced by a new task at 0. An old week that ended at five done with the gift task among them is also not paid out when the week changes. The same week with "사흘 들어오기" instead is paid (12 shells, 2 seeds).

What holds, confirmed in a browser:
- **New lines:** I collected every new or changed player-facing line. None says or implies what the octopus feels, likes or wants. None passes as the model's words, pushes the player or uses a symbol. Mechanically, every new Korean literal contains only Korean, ASCII, the middle dot or the ellipsis. On screen at 360x740 and 320x568, in both the pixel and plain font, the new toasts and sheet lines stay inside the screen with no sideways overflow.
- **Weekly list:** a stay-home answer, an empty turn and a walk each count once for "산책 갈지 묻기". A press that wakes a napping octopus does not count, whether the turn ends home or out. A press during the awake rest window does count. Walks change no shells or seeds. Last week's unclaimed gift is now put in the bag automatically, with one plain toast and one sheet line. There is no countdown or streak.
- **Upstairs:** after a turn, while the octopus rests awake, it does not follow the player up. Tapping the mirror then says "지금은 아래층에 있어.", which is true, and the screen-reader description says "문어는 아래층 담요 위에서 쉬고 있어". When it does follow while awake, it no longer wanders upstairs.
- **Salon:** a "그대로" answer is staged with the neutral face, nothing is paid, the octopus does not walk off within 12 s, and asking again the same day gives only "내일 또 물어볼 수 있어."
- **Intro:** stepping it frame by frame (187 frames at 1/60 s, at 360x740 by day and 320x568 at night), no frame pair has 25% or more of the screen changing brightness sharply. The largest was 19.5%, and there were no flashes. With reduced motion it lands at once.
- **Sound:** with sound off there was no AudioContext and no request under `audio/` or `foley/` through the intro, a walk out with an outside plot tap, the garden, the weekly claim, upstairs, the mirror and back down. With sound on, nothing new played at those moments; only the existing sheet and button clicks.
- **Credits and fonts:** the credits link "만든 것들" is in settings and credits.html shows the CC BY credit. No commercial game is named in the diff. The font check on a copy says "stale: none".

Smaller points:
- (nit) Harvesting a flower of unknown colour says "염료 1개를 얻었어", but the bag then shows "염료 아직 없어". This only happens with a hand-edited or foreign save.
- (nit) At 320x568 in the pixel font, the claim button starts at y=515 when the bag opens, so its quantity line and the `kept` line sit below the fold. The sheet scrolls.
- (owner) Two code-written feeling lines that are already in production: the pet bubble "…좋아" and the screen-reader phrase "신나 있어".
- (owner) The daily gift still pays an extra 10 shells every fifth visited day, which is an attendance reward. With this deploy it is also toasted when an open tab passes midnight.

Evidence (scripts, logs, screenshots, notes.md) is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v2-welfare/. I ran no repo suites, and I deleted the /dev/shm copies afterwards.

findings.title: Updating drops a done 'gift' weekly task from production saves; an earned unclaimed weekly gift disappears
findings.where: js/app.js:4351-4353 (QUESTS without 'gift'), 4362-4365 oldDone (only 'days'), 4370 weekState repair, 4380 due; screen: 살림 sheet '이번 주 할 일'
findings.what: Production f2c93f1 has the weekly task ['gift','선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기',1] and counts it (questMark('gift')). This deploy removes the task. weekState replaces an unknown task with a new one at n=0. The 'kept' credit (OW-1) is given only for 'days' and never for a done 'gift'. A production week with five done tasks, one of them 'gift', drops to 4/5 after the update: the claim button and the chip dot vanish, and the player must do another task to get back what they had already earned. An old week that ended five-done with 'gift' among them is not paid out at the week change (the same week with 'days' is). This breaks hard line 10 (a production save loses something it had) and the sheet's promise '못 해도 잃는 건 없어'.
findings.evidence: w1.log, case A (new build): q 'ask:2 loft:0 run:1 plant:1 harvest:1 look:0 diary:0', chip aria '살림, 조개 23' with no gift, sheet '(4/5)' and no claim button. w1-prod.log, same save on f2c93f1: q 'ask:2 gift:1 run:1 …', chip class 'has-gift', sheet '(5/5)'. A2 ('days' instead of 'gift'): kept 1, 5/5, claim shown. A3 (old week, 'gift' done): no prev and shells unchanged. A4 (old week, 'days' done): prev {shells 12, seeds 2}, shells 23 to 35. Screenshots w1-A-gift-week.png vs w1-PROD-A-gift-week.png.
findings.repro: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v2-welfare/w1-week.js (ONLY=A). For production: TREE=<copy of f2c93f1> ONLY=A node w1-prod.js
findings.suggested_fix: Treat a done 'gift' task like 'days' in oldDone (x.id === 'gift' && (x.n|0) >= 1 counts as kept), both in the same-week repair and in the week-change 'due' count. Make the kept line general, e.g. '목록에서 빠진 일도 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어.' (or one line per removed task). Add a smoke case seeded with a production week containing gift:1.

findings.title: Harvesting an unknown-colour flower says a dye was gained, but the bag then shows no dye
findings.where: js/app.js:4468 (toast) and the bag '염료' section; screen: 살림 sheet
findings.what: For a plot whose colour this build does not know (hand-edited or foreign save), harvest gives the toast '염료 1개를 얻었어' and stores dyes {teal: 1}, but the dye list says '아직 없어. 꽃을 길러 거두면 생겨.' The toast promises something the player cannot see or use.
findings.evidence: w2.log: dyes '{"teal":1}' after harvest toast '염료 1개를 얻었어'. w3.log: bag dyes section '염료 / 아직 없어. …' with dyes {teal:1}. Screenshot w2-360x740-pixel-toast-harvest.png.
findings.repro: node w2-lines.js and w3-toasts.js in the v2-welfare folder (seed garden [{color:'teal',water:2}] or dyes {teal:1})
findings.suggested_fix: For an unknown colour either say plainly '모르는 색이라 염료로 쓸 수 없어' (keeping the key), or list it in the bag as '모르는 색 1' so the toast and the sheet agree.

findings.title: At 320x568 in the pixel font the moved claim button is half below the fold when the bag opens
findings.where: css/style.css week claim / js/app.js:4435 renderWeek; screen: 살림 sheet at 320x568, pixel font
findings.what: The claim button was moved above the list so it is visible on open (F5). At 320x568 with the pixel font it starts at y=515 (height 76, viewport 568), so the quantity line '(조개 12 · 씨앗 2)' is cut at the screen edge, and the 'kept' line (y=591) is fully below. The sheet scrolls (overflow auto), so nothing is lost. Plain font and 360x740 are fine.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: tighten the bag-line and set-note spacing in the pixel theme at small heights, or accept it as scrollable.

findings.title: Two code-written feeling lines already in production: pet bubble '…좋아' and scene description '신나 있어'
findings.where: js/app.js:1619 (say('…좋아','pet',1800) after petting, 70%); js/app.js:1144 DOING_DESC.happy '신나 있어' (screen-reader #scene-desc, state set from reaction 폴짝/우쭐)
findings.what: Neither line is new in this deploy; both are identical in f2c93f1. Read literally, both state what the octopus feels and are written by code, not the model (hard line 1 names '좋아해' and '기뻐해' as banned). '…좋아' is documented as a deliberate replacement for '…♡' in docs/UI_ART.md:128. This deploy only touches it to clear a pending '…좋아' when the salon is asked (good). Options: (a) keep as a documented exception (costs: the line reads as the octopus saying it likes being petted, with no demo-rule tag); (b) replace the pet bubble with a neutral '…' or no text and keep the heart particle, and change '신나 있어' to a fact such as '폴짝 뛰고 있어' (costs: a little warmth, two strings).
findings.evidence: grep: js/app.js:1619 and git show f2c93f1:js/app.js:1589 identical; DOING_DESC identical at f2c93f1:1118. docs/UI_ART.md:128 "쓰다듬기 '…♡' | '…좋아'".
findings.suggested_fix: Owner choice; option (b) is the strict reading of hard line 1.

findings.title: The daily gift still pays +10 shells on every fifth visited day (an attendance reward), now also toasted at midnight in an open tab
findings.where: js/app.js:4340 dailyGift (extra = n % 5 === 0 ? 10 : 0); js/app.js:4650-4651 (new 60 s interval and visibilitychange)
findings.what: Decision 4b removed '이번 주에 사흘 들어오기' as a login chore, but the daily gift's fifth-day bonus is the same kind of reward for coming in. It counts total visited days, not consecutive ones, so it is not a streak. New in this deploy: a tab left open past midnight now grants the gift within a minute and shows '오늘 선물: 조개 N · 씨앗 1 (들어온 날 N일째)'. The toast only shows while the tab is visible and is not a push notification. Options: keep as is; drop the fifth-day bonus (flat 3 shells) to match 4b; or drop the '들어온 날 N일째' count from the toast.
findings.evidence: Code at the lines above; toast seen in w3.log at 3.3 s after boot ('오늘 선물: 조개 3 · 씨앗 1 (들어온 날 4일째)').
